title: SetsView.tab shadows the session's EmojiPanel.tab (Installed/Trending/Search) and is kept in step by hand
trigger: Open the emoji packs box, type a query (panel.tab=Search, view.tab=Installed), clear the field: the view tab decides which tab to go back to; select_emoji_sets_tab and show_emoji_sets_tab each write one of the two
effect: No wrong output today; a path that sets one tab without the other would show the highlighted tab and the list out of step
fix: One tab value in the panel with a separate Search { return_to } variant

title: event_log_ids (Cell<Vec<i64>>) mirrors the ListState item count and must be reset together with it
trigger: Any path that calls event_log_list.reset/splice without writing event_log_ids (or the reverse) leaves the plan_sync diff against rows that are not in the list
effect: List rows out of step with the entries (wrong or missing rows) until the next reset
fix: Keep the shown ids inside one owner that wraps the ListState and only changes through sync()

title: Reopening Share Folder while a link delete is still out asks for the list without waiting for the delete, so the deleted link comes back
trigger: In Share Folder press Delete on a link and confirm (LinkOp::Saving(request)), Done/close the box at once (close_folder_share hands the request to closed_asks as LinkChange), reopen Share Folder: open_folder_share -> driver.fetch_folder_share(folder_id), which (connect/folder_links.rs fetch_folder_share) only checks links.is_loading(), not a DeleteChatFolderInviteLink in flight; getChatFolderInviteLinks can be read before the delete lands. refetch_outdated_folder_links only runs when links.is_outdated() (a list that was loading when the delete was sent), and settle_closed_folder_asks LinkChange arm does nothing on success
effect: The deleted invite link is listed again (with copy/edit) until the box is reopened after the delete has landed; deleting it again errors
fix: fetch_folder_share waits for (or is re-sent on the answer of) the in-flight DeleteChatFolderInviteLink of that folder; the LinkChange ask refetches the list on success

title: A second addlist link opened while an add is out is dropped: the old box is shown and the new link is never checked
trigger: Add a shared folder (InviteStage::Adding), click another t.me/addlist link before the answer
effect: Box for the first folder re-raised; the second link silently ignored (comment says it waits, nothing remembers it)
fix: Keep the next link in the Adding stage (Adding { request, info, next }) and check it when the add settles, or say it was ignored

title: EventLogPage.poll Option<Task> is a running/stopped flag: the loop ends by itself (page closed, dialog left) and leaves Some(finished task)
trigger: Open Recent Actions (poll Some), close Group Settings: event_log_poll_tick sees event_log_open_chat() None, returns false and the task ends, but page.poll stays Some. Only the window-inactive path writes None, and resume_event_log_poll reads is_none() as 'stopped'. Today every entry into RecentActions calls start_event_log_poll (group_admin_settings.rs set_group_settings_view), which replaces it, so no stuck poll follows
effect: No wrong output today; a path that reaches the page without set_group_settings_view would see a dead poll treated as running
fix: enum PollStage { Stopped, Running(Task<()>) } that the loop's own exit sets to Stopped

title: Cancel in the Recent Actions filter box re-asks the whole log and restarts the poll
trigger: Recent Actions open, press Filter, press Cancel: close_event_log_filter -> set_group_settings_view(RecentActions), which runs start_event_log_poll, hook_event_log_scroll and driver.fetch_chat_event_log again for the same chat
effect: The list falls back to Loading and the reader loses their scroll place for a filter they did not change
fix: Entering a page the dialog already shows (RecentActions after its own RecentActionsFilter) only changes the view; the ask and poll start belong to the first open

title: CraftStage::Forging { request } in the UI and CraftSession.run (Crafting { request }) in the session are two stage holders for one craft, kept in step by hand
trigger: craft_now writes session craft.run (demo) / driver and then CraftStage::start_forge; craft_frame_upkeep compares craft.run == Crafting{request} and calls end_forge; after_craft_pop clears both separately (gift_market.craft = Idle and market.craft = None)
effect: No bug today; an exit that clears one and not the other leaves the forge box without its craft, or a craft with no forge to end
fix: One owner of the craft stage (the session's CraftRun), with the forge start time as its own variant data

title: GifTab::Asked is never left by itself: a window whose ask ended but whose list the session replaced stays Asked and shows Missing until a press
trigger: Open the GIF tab in a chat window (Wants -> Asking -> Asked), then search in the main window so the session's one GIF list holds another query and searches_kept lacks this window's; gif_tab_upkeep only asks from Wants, and follow_gif_wanted only runs for the window the user pressed in
effect: The non-pressed window's GIF tab can show an empty body (GifShown::Missing, no status text) until the user presses in it
fix: Asked leaves to Wants when gif_shown() is Missing and nothing is on its way, with the retry bounded by the request outcome
